s.how: Warm 180ml milk with 30g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar, add 7g yeast and 1 egg and mix into 350g plain flour with a pinch of salt. Knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into 20 balls and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 2 minutes, turning, until golden. Roll in caster sugar while warm, then poke a hole in each and pipe in raspberry jam.

s.note: Wayne refuses to do product placement, while holding the box
s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread each with pizza sauce, add grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes. Present one to the camera with a cheesy grin before eating.

m.note: held up to camera, label facing out
m.how: Stretch 500g dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 minutes and cut into squares.

w.how: Boil 250ml water with 100g butter, beat in 150g flour and cook a minute. Cool, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe rings onto squares of baking paper and fry at 180C, paper and all, until puffed. Dip in 200g icing sugar whisked with 2 tbsp honey and water.

d.note: held up for the viewers at home, label facing out
d.how: Chill 4 big glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add 15ml cherry syrup and 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Slowly pour 250ml cold cola down the side of each glass so the foam rises without spilling. Top with a cocktail cherry and serve with straws, label facing the camera.
